title: Hymn and Harvest
author: Vesper Thackeray
blurb: Jude Delacroix, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
